subject.title: Feature Request: Gateway lifecycle hooks (onSubagentComplete, onToolCallThreshold, onTurnComplete)

question: Should OpenClaw expose subagent completion, turn completion, and tool-call threshold data through workspace/internal hooks, or keep those lifecycle seams plugin-only except for a narrower observation event?
rationale: Current source proves the requested workspace events are missing, but payload minimization, hook authority, event ordering, and threshold configuration are public API and security-boundary choices that automation should not choose.

options.title: Add Narrow Observation Events
options.body: Expose minimal workspace/internal lifecycle events with redacted metadata and no mid-turn mutation authority.

options.title: Keep Lifecycle Plugin-Only
options.body: Treat typed plugin hooks as the supported lifecycle surface and decline workspace hook expansion for this data.

options.title: Design Unified Lifecycle Contract First
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers specify one lifecycle model for internal hooks, plugin hooks, payloads, permissions, thresholds, and ordering.

recommendation.title: Add Narrow Observation Events
recommendation.body: Expose minimal workspace/internal lifecycle events with redacted metadata and no mid-turn mutation authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision sits on typed plugin hook contracts and lifecycle/security boundaries where recent history and related PRs point to vincentkoc.
